adept-benefit-amulet.name: Amulet's Abeyance
adept-benefit-amulet.duration: until the start of your next turn
adept-benefit-amulet.note: Adept Benefit (Amulet): when you use Amulet's Abeyance, you or your ally chooses one damage type dealt by the triggering attack and gains resistance 5 against it (10 at 15th level). Set the type you chose; if the ally took it instead, leave this off.

item-aged-arbor-wine.name: Arbor Wine
item-aged-arbor-wine.note: You have tremorsense at a range of 30 feet. Aged wine also makes vegetation around you writhe into difficult terrain until the start of your next turn — that is battlefield-side, not on your sheet.

item-arbor-wine.name: Arbor Wine
item-arbor-wine.note: For 1 minute after drinking a glass, you have tremorsense at a range of 30 feet.

item-arctic-worm-chitin-shield.name: Misty Chill
item-arctic-worm-chitin-shield.duration: until the beginning of your next turn
item-arctic-worm-chitin-shield.note: Misty Chill: you Raise the Shield and gain resistance 5 to cold. Any creature that ends its turn adjacent to you takes 3d6 cold damage (basic save) — that damage lands on their sheet, not yours.

item-blood-booster-lesser.name: Blood Booster
item-blood-booster-lesser.note: Resistance 5 to persistent bleed and persistent poison damage. You also lower the DC of any flat check to end persistent bleed or persistent poison damage as if you had received particularly appropriate aid (DC 10).

item-bloodhound-mask-lesser.name: Bloodhound Mask
item-bloodhound-mask-lesser.note: Imprecise scent with a 15-foot range. When you use Survival to Track a creature by its scent, your proficiency bonus is equal to your level even if untrained. You can't wear another mask while wearing it.

modifiers.appliesWhen: to Track a creature by its scent

item-bloodhound-mask-moderate.name: Bloodhound Mask
item-bloodhound-mask-moderate.note: Imprecise scent with a 30-foot range. When you use Survival to Track a creature by its scent, your proficiency bonus is equal to your level even if untrained. You can't wear another mask while wearing it.

modifiers.appliesWhen: to Track a creature by its scent

item-bloodhound-mask-greater.name: Bloodhound Mask
item-bloodhound-mask-greater.note: Imprecise scent with a 60-foot range. When you use Survival to Track a creature by its scent, your proficiency bonus is equal to your level even if untrained. You can't wear another mask while wearing it.

modifiers.appliesWhen: to Track a creature by its scent

item-bloodhound-olfactory-stimulators.name: Olfactory Stimulators
item-bloodhound-olfactory-stimulators.note: Activate (once per day): your stimulators twitch and gather more information, giving you imprecise scent with a range of 30 feet.

break-the-suns-legs.name: Break the Sun's Legs
break-the-suns-legs.note: The stolen light is channeled to your eyes, granting you greater darkvision. The surrounding area is under a 9th-rank Darkness effect for the same minute — that part is on the battlefield, not your sheet.

item-chromatic-jellyfish-oil-lesser.name: Jellyfish Oil
item-chromatic-jellyfish-oil-lesser.note: Resistance 5 to precision damage and to the extra damage from critical hits. You also ignore difficult terrain from tight spaces that don't force you to Squeeze, move 5 feet per round when you succeed at Squeeze (10 feet on a critical success), and can Crawl at half your Speed.

item-clockwork-goggles.name: Clockwork Goggles
item-clockwork-goggles.note: The lenses cycle rapidly, granting you low-light vision.

item-clockwork-goggles-greater.name: Clockwork Goggles
item-clockwork-goggles-greater.note: The lenses cycle rapidly, granting you low-light vision and darkvision.

item-clockwork-goggles-major.name: Clockwork Goggles
item-clockwork-goggles-major.note: Low-light vision, darkvision, and the effects of See the Unseen — invisible creatures are concealed to you rather than undetected.

close-formation.name: Close Formation
close-formation.duration: while wielding two fans, one in each hand
close-formation.note: Fan-dance spatial awareness: while you wield two fans, each in a different hand, you gain tremorsense as an imprecise sense with a range of 20 feet.

curse-of-creeping-ashes-1.name: Creeping Ashes 1
curse-of-creeping-ashes-1.note: Cursebound 1: weakness 2 to fire damage. Any immunity or resistance you have to fire is suppressed.

curse-of-creeping-ashes-2.name: Creeping Ashes 2
curse-of-creeping-ashes-2.note: Cursebound 2 (cumulative): weakness 2 to fire with any fire immunity or resistance suppressed, plus swirling ash imposing a −2 circumstance penalty to your ranged attack rolls.

curse-of-creeping-ashes-3.name: Creeping Ashes 3
curse-of-creeping-ashes-3.note: Cursebound 3 (cumulative): your weakness to fire is 5 + your level and any fire immunity or resistance is suppressed; the −2 circumstance penalty to ranged attack rolls continues.

curse-of-creeping-ashes-4.name: Creeping Ashes 4
curse-of-creeping-ashes-4.note: Cursebound 4 (cumulative): fire weakness 5 + your level, −2 circumstance to ranged attack rolls, and a −10-foot status penalty to all your Speeds as your limbs crumble — apply that Speed penalty by hand, the mode can't.

curse-of-inclement-headwinds-1.name: Headwinds 1
curse-of-inclement-headwinds-1.note: Cursebound 1: electricity weakness 2. Electricity spells and effects with extra effects against a creature wearing or holding metal treat you as wearing metal, and any immunity or resistance you have to them is suppressed.

curse-of-inclement-headwinds-2.name: Headwinds 2
curse-of-inclement-headwinds-2.note: Cursebound 2 (cumulative): electricity weakness 2 and you count as wearing metal for electricity effects, plus blowing winds imposing a −2 circumstance penalty to your ranged attack rolls.

curse-of-inclement-headwinds-3.name: Headwinds 3
curse-of-inclement-headwinds-3.note: Cursebound 3 (cumulative): your weakness to electricity is 5 + your level, you still count as wearing metal for electricity effects, and the −2 circumstance penalty to ranged attack rolls continues.

curse-of-inclement-headwinds-4.name: Headwinds 4
curse-of-inclement-headwinds-4.note: Cursebound 4 (cumulative): electricity weakness 5 + your level, −2 circumstance to ranged attack rolls, and the raging winds push you back for a −10-foot status penalty to all your Speeds — apply that Speed penalty by hand, the mode can't.

curse-of-inevitable-rot-1.name: Inevitable Rot 1
curse-of-inevitable-rot-1.note: Cursebound 1: you gain weakness 2 to acid and poison damage.

curse-of-inevitable-rot-2.name: Inevitable Rot 2
curse-of-inevitable-rot-2.note: Cursebound 2 (cumulative): weakness 2 to acid and poison, and a −1 status penalty to saves against diseases and poisons. Anyone attempting to Treat your Disease, Poison, or Wounds also takes −1 — that penalty is on their sheet.

curse-of-inevitable-rot-3.name: Inevitable Rot 3
curse-of-inevitable-rot-3.note: Cursebound 3 (cumulative): your weakness to acid and poison damage increases to twice your level; the −1 status penalty to saves against diseases and poisons continues (and −1 for anyone treating you).

curse-of-inevitable-rot-4.name: Inevitable Rot 4
curse-of-inevitable-rot-4.note: Cursebound 4 (cumulative): acid and poison weakness twice your level, and the status penalty to saves against diseases and poisons increases to −2 (as does the penalty for anyone attempting to Treat your Disease, Poison, or Wounds).

curse-of-the-living-death-1.name: Living Death 1
curse-of-the-living-death-1.note: Cursebound 1. You can be targeted by and are hurt by both vitality and void damage even if one normally has no effect on you (Heal can damage you), and any immunity or resistance you have to vitality or void is suppressed.

curse-of-the-living-death-2.name: Living Death 2
curse-of-the-living-death-2.note: Cursebound 2 (includes stage 1). Vitality and void still reach you through any immunity or resistance you have.

curse-of-the-living-death-3.name: Living Death 3
curse-of-the-living-death-3.note: Cursebound 3. The weakness rises to 5 + your level; vitality and void still reach you through any immunity or resistance.

curse-of-the-living-death-4.name: Living Death 4
curse-of-the-living-death-4.note: Cursebound 4. The Fortitude penalty doubles; vitality and void still reach you through any immunity or resistance.

curse-of-the-mortal-warrior-1.name: Mortal Warrior 1
curse-of-the-mortal-warrior-1.note: Cursebound 1. Any immunity or resistance you have to spells is suppressed. This applies only to spells, not other magical abilities.

curse-of-the-mortal-warrior-2.name: Mortal Warrior 2
curse-of-the-mortal-warrior-2.note: Cursebound 2 (includes stage 1). Any immunity or resistance you have to spells is still suppressed.

curse-of-the-mortal-warrior-3.name: Mortal Warrior 3
curse-of-the-mortal-warrior-3.note: Cursebound 3. Your weakness to spell damage equals your level; immunity or resistance to spells stays suppressed.

curse-of-the-mortal-warrior-4.name: Mortal Warrior 4
curse-of-the-mortal-warrior-4.note: Cursebound 4. The penalty on saves against spells doubles; immunity or resistance to spells stays suppressed.

item-darkvision-elixir-lesser.name: Darkvision
item-darkvision-elixir-lesser.note: Your sight becomes sharper in darkness.

item-darkvision-elixir-moderate.name: Darkvision
item-darkvision-elixir-moderate.note: Your sight becomes sharper in darkness.

item-darkvision-elixir-greater.name: Darkvision
item-darkvision-elixir-greater.note: Your sight becomes sharper in darkness. Lasts a full day, so a night's rest doesn't end it.

item-deployable-cover-ballistic-cover.name: Ballistic Cover
item-deployable-cover-ballistic-cover.duration: While you have cover from Take Cover behind it
item-deployable-cover-ballistic-cover.note: The resistance applies only while a creature has cover from Taking Cover behind the deployed ballistic cover. The standard cover itself (+2 circumstance to AC) comes from Take Cover, not from this mode. Refolding the cover before reuse takes 1 minute.

resistances.type: piercing damage from ranged weapons and ranged unarmed attacks

item-devilwing-badge.name: Devilwing Badge (Armor)
item-devilwing-badge.note: The spellheart's armor option. Affixed to a WEAPON instead, it gives no resistance — your Strikes deal an extra 1d4 spirit damage until the end of your next turn after you cast a spell by Activating it. Activating it casts Divine Lance (spell attack +8, DC 18).

item-devilwing-badge-greater.name: Devilwing Badge (Armor)
item-devilwing-badge-greater.note: The spellheart's armor option. Affixed to a WEAPON instead, it gives no resistance — your Strikes deal an extra 1d6 spirit damage until the end of your next turn after you cast a spell by Activating it. Activating it casts Divine Lance (spell attack +14, DC 24), or Crisis of Faith once per day.

dissolutions-sight.name: Dissolution's Sight
dissolutions-sight.note: Once per hour. Accepting your inner darkness means no outer darkness can obscure your sight.

item-draft-of-stellar-radiance.name: Stellar Radiance
item-draft-of-stellar-radiance.note: You emanate bright light in a 20-foot radius (dim light for another 20 feet). Any creature that targets you with an attack or ability must succeed at a save or be dazzled for 1 round; a creature that succeeds is immune to that effect for 24 hours.

item-dragons-eye-charm.name: Golden Shroud
item-dragons-eye-charm.note: The charm's golden-shroud activation (once per day). Its three other once-per-day activations are separate and not covered here: a 5th-rank Ignition (spell attack +13); looking through the pupil for darkvision while you Sustain, up to 10 minutes; and speaking and understanding Draconic while you Sustain, up to 10 minutes. Track those yourself.

echoes-in-stone.name: Echoes in Stone
echoes-in-stone.duration: Until the start of your next turn
echoes-in-stone.note: Requires that you are standing on a stone or earthen surface.

item-elder-seed.name: Elder Seed (Stage 1)
item-elder-seed.note: Stage 1 of the boon. You can also cast Enlarge, Speak with Animals, Speak with Plants and Web each once per day as primal innate spells. Later stages are not modelled here: stage 2 (1 month) adds low-light vision, Arboreal, Clumsy 1, a -1 status penalty to initiative and a weakness to fire and to axes equal to half your level; stage 3 (1 month) raises those to Clumsy 2, -2 initiative and a weakness equal to your level, and makes you Slowed on every initiative roll; stage 4 kills you. Purging ends the effects.

energetic-meltdown.name: Moderate Backlash
energetic-meltdown.note: Moderate Backlash from Energetic Meltdown. You also lose immunity to that energy type, if you had it, until your next daily preparations. (Mild Backlash is only damage equal to your level; Severe Backlash is a burst dealing 1d6 per level, which you take in full without a save.)

item-energy-adaptive.name: Energy Adaptive
item-energy-adaptive.duration: Until you Activate the rune again or the armor is no longer invested
item-energy-adaptive.note: Activated as a reaction-style 5-action activation, once per hour, triggered by taking acid, cold, electricity or fire damage. The resistance does NOT apply to the triggering damage. Only one energy type can be active at a time — the app can't know which one you picked, so read this row as the type you triggered on.

resistances.type: the triggering energy type (acid, cold, electricity or fire)

item-energy-mutagen-lesser.name: Energy Mutagen
item-energy-mutagen-lesser.note: The mutagen is attuned to one of acid, cold, electricity or fire when it is created — the app can't know which, so the two rows below name the type rather than fixing it. Benefit also: whenever you score a hit with a melee weapon, add 1 damage of the attuned type.

weaknesses.type: each of the other three energy types

item-energy-mutagen-moderate.name: Energy Mutagen
item-energy-mutagen-moderate.note: The mutagen is attuned to one of acid, cold, electricity or fire when it is created — the app can't know which, so the two rows below name the type rather than fixing it. Benefit also: whenever you score a hit with a melee weapon, add 1d4 damage of the attuned type.

weaknesses.type: each of the other three energy types

item-energy-mutagen-greater.name: Energy Mutagen
item-energy-mutagen-greater.note: The mutagen is attuned to one of acid, cold, electricity or fire when it is created — the app can't know which, so the two rows below name the type rather than fixing it. Benefit also: whenever you score a hit with a melee weapon, add 1d6 damage of the attuned type; and you can end the mutagen as a 2-action activity to unleash a burst dealing 2d6 of the attuned type per full 10 minutes of remaining duration (max 8d6), with a save.

weaknesses.type: each of the other three energy types

item-energy-mutagen-major.name: Energy Mutagen
item-energy-mutagen-major.note: The mutagen is attuned to acid, cold, electricity or fire when it is made: apply the resistance 20 to that type and the weakness 5 to the other three. Benefit also adds 2d6 damage of the attuned type on every melee weapon hit, and you can end the mutagen to unleash a burst dealing 3d6 per full 10 minutes remaining (max 12d6).

extract-vow-of-nonviolence.name: Vow of Nonviolence
extract-vow-of-nonviolence.note: On a critical success the weapon swears not to hurt you; on a plain success the remaining duration also drops by 1 minute each time that weapon hits you. The resistance covers only damage dealt by that one weapon.

resistances.type: damage from the weapon that swore the vow

feral-senses.name: Feral Senses
feral-senses.duration: while in your hybrid or animal shape
feral-senses.note: Werecreature archetype: these senses last only while the hybrid or animal shape is up.

item-fire-and-iceberg.name: Fire and Iceberg
item-fire-and-iceberg.note: Eating the salad leaves a lasting sense of heat and cold.

item-force-shield.name: Force Bubble
item-force-shield.note: Once per day. The bubble ends early if you stop holding the shield.

item-forge-warden.name: Forge Warden
item-forge-warden.note: Adjacent allies gain the same fire resistance 5, but that belongs on their sheets.

form-a-flock.name: Form a Flock
form-a-flock.note: The flock also grants 25 temporary Hit Points and ends when they are gone, the minute elapses, or you Dismiss it. Enemies in the flock aura are dazzled, and you can take the Acrid Barrage action while it lasts.

fresh-produce.name: Fresh Produce
fresh-produce.note: Only if you eat the produce yourself; you also feel full and can't eat another piece while it lasts. Resistance is 2 at 1st level and increases by 2 for every 2 levels.

item-frost-breath.name: Frost Breath
item-frost-breath.note: Ends when you exhale the breath as the single-action cone of frigid air.

item-galvanic-chew.name: Galvanic Chew
item-galvanic-chew.note: Ends early if you spend the Secondary Effect reaction, which makes the chew inert and leaves you temporarily immune to galvanic chews for 24 hours.

geomancer-dedication.name: Underground Attunement
geomancer-dedication.note: Terrain attunement after expending a slot on an earth spell underground. The other self-affecting attunements aren't tracked here: Aquatic grants a swim Speed, Sky lets you Fly 10 feet, Mountain gives resistance to physical damage (except adamantine) equal to the spell's rank, and Plains gives temporary Hit Points equal to the spell's rank. Arctic, Desert, Forest and Swamp affect enemies only.

item-ghostcallers-planchette.name: Planchette (Armor)
item-ghostcallers-planchette.duration: until the start of your next turn
item-ghostcallers-planchette.note: Only while the spellheart is affixed to armor, and only after you cast a spell by Activating it. Ghost touch attacks — including attacks by incorporeal creatures — ignore the resistance. Affixed to a weapon instead, it gives that weapon ghost touch until the end of your next turn.

item-goz-mask-major.name: Goz Mask
item-goz-mask-major.note: Once per day. You also ignore all concealment from environmental effects such as fog, rain and storms.

item-grim-specter.name: Grim Specter
item-grim-specter.note: Once per day. You become incorporeal: immune to effects that require a physical body (including precision damage) and to exposure to MOST diseases and poisons — the GM decides which ones still reach you, so they are not listed as blanket immunities. You also gain resistance to all damage equal to half the relic's level (doubled against non-magical damage); force damage, ghost touch attacks, spirit, void and vitality damage ignore it — track that by hand, the app doesn't know the relic's level. You can move through solid objects but are slowed 1 on any turn you start inside one, and you can't attempt or be the target of Strength-based checks against corporeal creatures.
immunities: effects that require a physical body

item-grolna.name: Grolna
item-grolna.note: You are also stupefied 1 for the hour. Stage 2 is stupefied 2 for 6 hours, with a maximum duration of 8 hours; another dose during stage 1 resets stage 1 and postpones stage 2.

harden-flesh.name: Harden Flesh
harden-flesh.duration: until the beginning of your next turn
harden-flesh.note: Requires standing on earthen or stone ground. Resistance 3, increasing by 1 at 12th level and every 4 levels after, to a maximum of 6 at 20th.

item-horned-lion-amulet.name: Horned Lion
item-horned-lion-amulet.note: The triggering fire damage is instead reduced by fire resistance 10; the lasting resistance 5 is what this pill tracks. If the trigger was persistent fire damage, you immediately attempt a flat check to end it, and its DC stays 10 until it ends.

kinetic-dampening.name: Kinetic Dampening
kinetic-dampening.duration: until the beginning of your next turn
kinetic-dampening.note: Resistance 5 to physical damage, increasing by 5 at 10th level and every 4 levels after. With the second Awakening you also gain the same resistance to your choice of fire, electricity or sonic — add that one by hand, since the app can't record the choice. The first Awakening's ally emanation isn't modelled.

item-living-statue.name: Living Statue
item-living-statue.note: Only while you are standing on the earth. The resistance increases from 5 to 8 in caves or subterranean environments.

item-maelstromic-destabilizer-lesser.name: Destabilizer (Lesser)
item-maelstromic-destabilizer-lesser.note: The creature holding the gadget gains resistance 2 to spirit damage. The weakness 2 to spirit damage the destabilizer inflicts on creatures in its emanation is target-facing and isn't applied to your sheet.

item-maelstromic-destabilizer-moderate.name: Destabilizer (Moderate)
item-maelstromic-destabilizer-moderate.note: The creature holding the gadget gains resistance 5 to spirit damage. The weakness 5 to spirit damage the destabilizer inflicts on creatures in its emanation is target-facing and isn't applied to your sheet.

item-maelstromic-destabilizer-major.name: Destabilizer (Major)
item-maelstromic-destabilizer-major.note: The creature holding the gadget gains resistance 10 to spirit damage. The weakness 10 to spirit damage the destabilizer inflicts on creatures in its emanation is target-facing and isn't applied to your sheet.

item-saurian-spike-major.name: Saurian Spike (Armor)
item-saurian-spike-major.note: While the spellheart is affixed to armor you gain precise scent with a range of 60 feet. The weapon-affixed benefit (frightening battle forms) is target-facing.

scouring-spark.name: Scouring Spark
scouring-spark.note: You are immune to confused and frightened. Your unarmed attacks deal 1d6 additional fire damage and your fire spells deal one extra die of fire damage (doubled against aberrations, fiends and undead) — those damage riders aren't applied to your Strikes yet. The 3d6 to creatures that touch or hit you is target-facing.

shadow-master.name: Shadow Master
shadow-master.note: Only while you are in an area of dim light or darkness. In dim light or darkness you may also roll Reflex saves twice and take the higher result (fortune).

resistances.type: all except force and damage from Ghost Touch Strikes

shadow-sight.name: Shadow Sight
shadow-sight.note: Once per hour, a single action: you gain greater darkvision for 1 minute.

spell-survivor.name: Spell Survivor
spell-survivor.duration: until the end of that caster's next turn
spell-survivor.note: Triggered by critically succeeding at a save against a spell using Orc Superstition or Pervasive Superstition. Resistance 1 to all damage dealt by that caster, increasing by 1 at 9th level and every 4 levels thereafter.

item-spiny-lodestone.name: Spiny Lodestone (Armor)
item-spiny-lodestone.note: While the spellheart is affixed to metal armor. The weapon-affixed benefit (extra 1d4 piercing on Strikes after Activating it) isn't modelled.

item-spiny-lodestone-greater.name: Spiny Lodestone (Greater, Armor)
item-spiny-lodestone-greater.note: While the spellheart is affixed to metal armor. The weapon-affixed benefit (extra 1d6 piercing on Strikes after Activating it) isn't modelled.

item-spun-cloud-blue.name: Spun Cloud (Blue)
item-spun-cloud-blue.note: Only while you are inside the exhaled blue cloud, which dissipates after 1 minute. Creatures in the cloud gain resistance 5 to electricity.

starlight-armor.name: Starlight Armor
starlight-armor.note: Once per day. Resistance 7 to piercing, bludgeoning and slashing, increasing to 10 at 17th level. The armor also sheds bright light for 20 feet; the dazzling save adjacent attackers must attempt is target-facing. Paizo printed no duration — 1 minute is the value the linked effect uses.

item-stone-body-mutagen-lesser.name: Stone Body (Lesser)
item-stone-body-mutagen-lesser.note: Benefit: resistance 5 to physical damage except bludgeoning. Drawback: -2 to Reflex saves, and all your Speeds are reduced by 10 feet (minimum 5 feet) — the Speed reduction is not applied to the sheet, track it yourself.

item-stone-body-mutagen-moderate.name: Stone Body (Moderate)
item-stone-body-mutagen-moderate.note: Benefit: resistance 5 to physical damage except bludgeoning. Drawback: -2 to Reflex saves, and all your Speeds are reduced by 10 feet (minimum 5 feet) — the Speed reduction is not applied to the sheet, track it yourself.

item-storm-breath.name: Storm Breath
item-storm-breath.note: After inhaling the storm breath you have resistance 5 to electricity and sonic. Exhaling it ends the effect and instead deals damage to creatures in the area with a save.

item-sun-slayer.name: Sun Slayer Raised
item-sun-slayer.note: While you have this shield raised you gain fire resistance 5. Its separate Sunset activation (once per day, in sunlight) only dims light in an area — nothing on your own sheet.

item-swarmsuit.name: Swarmsuit
item-swarmsuit.note: Resistance 3 to physical damage from swarms. Explorer's clothing altered this way has a Dex cap of +2, check penalty -1 and Speed penalty -5 feet regardless of your Strength.

item-tallowheart-mass.name: Tallowheart Fire Ward
item-tallowheart-mass.note: Rubbing a portion on your body grants resistance 10 to fire for 1 minute. The mass has three portions; the other two activations instead grant quickened 1 (extra action only for Strikes with weapons you wield in your hands) or restore 4d8+12 Hit Points.

item-thorn-of-milani-lesser.name: Thorn of Milani
item-thorn-of-milani-lesser.duration: Until the end of your next turn
item-thorn-of-milani-lesser.note: Activating the thorn on a hit deals an extra 1d4 spirit damage with the holy trait (instantaneous), then leaves you with weakness 1 to unholy.

item-thorn-triad.name: Thorn Triad (Armor)
item-thorn-triad.duration: Until the end of your next turn
item-thorn-triad.note: After casting a plant spell by activating the triad. Double the resistance (to 4) if the spell was not a cantrip. The Weapon benefit instead adds 1d4 persistent bleed to your Strikes with the affixed weapon.

item-thorn-triad-greater.name: Thorn Triad (Greater)
item-thorn-triad-greater.duration: Until the end of your next turn
item-thorn-triad-greater.note: After casting a plant spell by activating the triad. Double the resistance (to 8) if the spell was not a cantrip. The Weapon benefit instead adds 1d6 persistent bleed to your Strikes with the affixed weapon.

item-thorn-triad-major.name: Thorn Triad (Major)
item-thorn-triad-major.duration: Until the end of your next turn
item-thorn-triad-major.note: After casting a plant spell by activating the triad. Double the resistance (to 12) if the spell was not a cantrip. The Weapon benefit instead adds 1d8 persistent bleed to your Strikes with the affixed weapon.

item-tremorsensors.name: Tremorsensors
item-tremorsensors.note: Once per day. You stomp, clap or make some other sound to gain tremorsense as an imprecise sense with a range of 20 feet.

vengeful-remnant.name: Vengeful Remnant
vengeful-remnant.duration: Until the start of your next turn
vengeful-remnant.note: Once per day. Resistance 10 to all damage except force, ghost touch, spirit and vitality — doubled to 20 when the damage source is non-magical (the second entry; only one applies to a given source). If you slay a significant foe not immune to spirit damage with your Spectral Dagger while this is up, it lasts until the end of your next turn instead.

resistances.type: all damage except force, ghost touch, spirit, and vitality
non-magical damage (except force, ghost touch, spirit, and vitality)

item-victory-plate.name: Victory Plate
item-victory-plate.note: Once per hour, recall one recorded triumph. Resistance 5 to one damage type set by that creature's trait — aberration or fey: mental; celestial: good; construct: poison; dragon or elemental: one matching energy type; fiend: evil; undead: void. An ooze instead gives resistance 10 to precision. Only one type applies even if several traits could.

item-warcallers-chime-of-resistance.name: Chime of Resistance
item-warcallers-chime-of-resistance.note: Once per week. Choose acid, cold, electricity, fire or sonic as you activate the chime. The defensive aura also gives that resistance to other creatures inside it — their sheets, not yours.

resistances.type: chosen damage type (acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic)

item-warming-parka.name: Extra Warming
item-warming-parka.note: Once per day, Dismissable. Drawing the hood closed gives resistance 3 to cold but a -2 item penalty to Perception. The parka's always-on protection (negates severe environmental cold, reduces extreme to severe and incredible to extreme) applies whether or not this is toggled.

item-witchs-finger.name: Witch's Finger
item-witchs-finger.note: Cold resistance 3 for 1 hour. For 8 hours it also negates the damage from severe environmental cold and reduces extreme cold damage to that of severe cold.

item-wyrm-spindle.name: Wyrm Spindle (Armor)
item-wyrm-spindle.note: Armor benefit, after you cast a non-cantrip spell by activating the spindle. The Weapon benefit instead grants a 2-action Dragon Breath (6d6 fire, force, mental or spirit in an area with a save) usable once before the end of your next turn.

item-zetogeki-hide-armor.name: Shift Scales
item-zetogeki-hide-armor.duration: until the end of your next turn
item-zetogeki-hide-armor.note: Once per day. While the scales are shifted your Speeds are ALSO reduced by 10 feet (minimum 5 feet) — the app can't apply that yet, so lower your Speeds by hand.

item-bioluminescent-stripes.name: Glowing Stripes
item-bioluminescent-stripes.note: You shed bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for the next 20 feet, and you can't be undetected. Dismiss as a free action.

modifiers.appliesWhen: on Stealth checks to Hide and Sneak

item-blessed-tattoo.name: Blessed Tattoo
item-blessed-tattoo.note: Once per day; grants the effect of Protection (+1 status bonus to AC and saving throws). Can be activated as a reaction instead of a 2-action activity when a demon attacks you or you attempt a save against a demon's ability.

electric-counter.name: Electric Counter
electric-counter.duration: until the start of your next turn
electric-counter.note: Reaction while in Wild Winds Stance when you would take damage; the resistance also applies to the triggering damage if it was electricity. If the trigger was a melee attack, the attacker takes 3d6 damage.

gathering-moss.name: Gathering Moss
gathering-moss.duration: 1 minute or until Tenacious Stance ends
gathering-moss.note: Fast healing equal to your level (triggered when you enter Tenacious Stance). Track the healing yourself — the app has no fast-healing lane.

immortal-techniques.name: Immortal Techniques
immortal-techniques.duration: until the start of your next turn
immortal-techniques.note: The first time each round you use an action with both the monk and stance traits, you gain 20 temporary Hit Points. Enter them in the temporary HP box yourself.

item-leopards-armor.name: Leopard's Ferocity
item-leopards-armor.note: Once per day; Activate the armor again to revert it to its original form.

item-pyrefeather-token.name: Pyrefeather Token
item-pyrefeather-token.note: 5 temporary Hit Points — enter them in the temporary HP box yourself. Activating also reduces the triggering recovery check's DC by 1; you can Activate it while unconscious.

renewing-cycle.name: Renewing Cycle
renewing-cycle.duration: until the start of your next turn
renewing-cycle.note: The first time each round you Cycle Elemental Stance you gain temporary Hit Points equal to half your level — enter them yourself. You can't gain them again from the same elemental stance until you've entered every other elemental stance you know, or 10 minutes pass.

stone-body.name: Stone Body
stone-body.duration: until the end of your next turn
stone-body.note: Requires Tenacious Stance. Ends immediately if you are critically hit.

raging-stories.name: Raging Stories
raging-stories.duration: for the duration of Offer a Story
raging-stories.note: Taken in place of Offer a Story's normal benefits: you wrap yourself in spectral flame and the action gains the fire trait. The extra damage is fire and applies only to melee Strikes.

modifiers.appliesWhen: on melee Strikes, as fire damage (4 if you're a master in Religion, 6 if legendary)

item-thousand-year-dragonroot.name: Dragonroot Flight
item-thousand-year-dragonroot.note: Fly Speed 40 feet and fire resistance 5 for 1 minute.

item-soaring-wings-major.name: Soaring Wings
item-soaring-wings-major.note: Fly Speed equal to your land Speed or 20 feet, whichever is greater.

item-winged.name: Take to the Skies
item-winged.note: Fly Speed of 25 feet or your land Speed, whichever is slower. Once per hour.

item-wyrms-flight.name: Wyrm's Flight
item-wyrms-flight.note: Fly Speed equal to your Speed or 20 feet, whichever is greater. Once per day.

klingegeist.name: Possess a Blade
klingegeist.note: Fly Speed 30 feet while possessing the blade. You can take only Strike and Fly actions, and they do not trigger reactions.

item-siccatite-buckler-standard-grade-ho.name: Hot Siccatite Buckler
item-siccatite-buckler-standard-grade-ho.note: While Raised, a hot siccatite buckler grants resistance 5 to cold — the opposing energy type. Switch on the one matching your shield.

item-siccatite-buckler-standard-grade-co.name: Cold Siccatite Buckler
item-siccatite-buckler-standard-grade-co.note: While Raised, a cold siccatite buckler grants resistance 5 to fire — the opposing energy type. Switch on the one matching your shield.

item-siccatite-shield-standard-grade-hot.name: Hot Siccatite Shield
item-siccatite-shield-standard-grade-hot.note: While Raised, a hot siccatite shield grants resistance 5 to cold — the opposing energy type. Switch on the one matching your shield.

item-siccatite-shield-standard-grade-col.name: Cold Siccatite Shield
item-siccatite-shield-standard-grade-col.note: While Raised, a cold siccatite shield grants resistance 5 to fire — the opposing energy type. Switch on the one matching your shield.

item-siccatite-buckler-high-grade-hot.name: Hot Siccatite Buckler
item-siccatite-buckler-high-grade-hot.note: While Raised, a hot siccatite buckler grants resistance 10 to cold — the opposing energy type. Switch on the one matching your shield.

item-siccatite-buckler-high-grade-cold.name: Cold Siccatite Buckler
item-siccatite-buckler-high-grade-cold.note: While Raised, a cold siccatite buckler grants resistance 10 to fire — the opposing energy type. Switch on the one matching your shield.

item-siccatite-shield-high-grade-hot.name: Hot Siccatite Shield
item-siccatite-shield-high-grade-hot.note: While Raised, a hot siccatite shield grants resistance 10 to cold — the opposing energy type. Switch on the one matching your shield.

item-siccatite-shield-high-grade-cold.name: Cold Siccatite Shield
item-siccatite-shield-high-grade-cold.note: While Raised, a cold siccatite shield grants resistance 10 to fire — the opposing energy type. Switch on the one matching your shield.

cat-inner-fire-stoked-flame.name: Inner Fire (Stoked Flame Stance)
cat-inner-fire-stoked-flame.note: While in Stoked Flame Stance: cold and fire resistance equal to half your level. Any creature that hits you with an unarmed attack, tries to Grab or Grapple you, or otherwise touches you takes fire damage equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1), no more than once per turn.

segmented-frame-collapsed.name: Innovation collapsed
segmented-frame-collapsed.note: Segmented Frame: collapsed to light Bulk your innovation has the concealable trait — +2 circumstance to Stealth checks and to DCs to hide or conceal the weapon. Interact to collapse or restore it.

item-emotion-surge-anger.name: Emotion Surge (Anger)
item-emotion-surge-anger.note: A surge from your relic grants +1 status to Athletics checks for 1 minute. Once per hour. Switch on the emotion your relic actually has.

item-emotion-surge-awe.name: Emotion Surge (Awe)
item-emotion-surge-awe.note: A surge from your relic grants +1 status to Performance checks for 1 minute. Once per hour. Switch on the emotion your relic actually has.

item-emotion-surge-dedication.name: Emotion Surge (Dedication)
item-emotion-surge-dedication.note: A surge from your relic grants +1 status to checks to Recall Knowledge for 1 minute. Once per hour. Switch on the emotion your relic actually has.

item-emotion-surge-fear.name: Emotion Surge (Fear)
item-emotion-surge-fear.note: A surge from your relic grants +1 status to Stealth checks for 1 minute. Once per hour. Switch on the emotion your relic actually has.

item-emotion-surge-hatred.name: Emotion Surge (Hatred)
item-emotion-surge-hatred.note: A surge from your relic grants +1 status to Intimidation checks for 1 minute. Once per hour. Switch on the emotion your relic actually has.

item-emotion-surge-joy.name: Emotion Surge (Joy)
item-emotion-surge-joy.note: A surge from your relic grants +1 status to Diplomacy checks for 1 minute. Once per hour. Switch on the emotion your relic actually has.

item-emotion-surge-love.name: Emotion Surge (Love)
item-emotion-surge-love.note: A surge from your relic grants +1 status to Medicine checks for 1 minute. Once per hour. Switch on the emotion your relic actually has.

item-emotion-surge-misery.name: Emotion Surge (Misery)
item-emotion-surge-misery.note: A surge from your relic grants +1 status to Survival checks for 1 minute. Once per hour. Switch on the emotion your relic actually has.

item-emotion-surge-pride.name: Emotion Surge (Pride)
item-emotion-surge-pride.note: A surge from your relic grants +1 status to Society checks for 1 minute. Once per hour. Switch on the emotion your relic actually has.

item-emotion-surge-remorse.name: Emotion Surge (Remorse)
item-emotion-surge-remorse.note: A surge from your relic grants +1 status to Deception checks for 1 minute. Once per hour. Switch on the emotion your relic actually has.

armored-resistance.name: Armored Resistance
armored-resistance.duration: while you Intercept an Attack in medium or heavy armor
armored-resistance.note: Armored Resistance: this resistance applies ONLY to the damage you take in your ally's place with Intercept Attack, and only while you wear medium or heavy armor. Switch it on when you Intercept.

echolocation.name: Echolocation
echolocation.duration: until the start of your next turn
echolocation.note: Switch this on after you Seek: until the start of your next turn you can use hearing as a precise sense with a range of 40 feet. You can also use this sense while you Search.

axe-climber.name: Axe Climbing
axe-climber.duration: while climbing wood with an axe in each hand (or ice with two light picks)
axe-climber.note: Climbing a wooden surface with a Hatchet or Battle Axe in each hand (or ice with a Light Pick in each hand) gives you a climb Speed equal to half your Speed. You still need both legs free and can't use either axe in combat while climbing.

battle-scars.name: Battle Scars (vs. devils)
battle-scars.duration: while taking bludgeoning or slashing damage from devils or Chelaxian-allied creatures
battle-scars.note: Resistance to bludgeoning and slashing damage equal to half your level, but ONLY from devils and creatures allied with the Chelaxian government (the GM determines which creatures qualify). Leave the mode off against anything else.

canopy-predator.name: Canopy Predator
canopy-predator.duration: while moving through trees, vines, and other foliage
canopy-predator.note: A success on an Athletics check to Climb a tree or an Acrobatics check to Balance on a branch is a critical success instead, and you aren't off-guard while Climbing or Balancing on a tree.

cyclonic-ascent.name: Cyclonic Ascent
cyclonic-ascent.note: Fly Speed equal to your land Speed or 30 feet, whichever is greater, for 10 minutes. You can move upward without treating it as difficult terrain, and you can stay aloft at the end of your turn if you used an air impulse that turn. At 14th level you can also give up to five other creatures a fly Speed - that is ally-side, not on your sheet.

deadeye.name: Deadeye
deadeye.duration: until the start of your next turn
deadeye.note: Until the start of your next turn you see invisible creatures and objects as silhouettes, making them merely concealed from you rather than undetected.

defiant-banner.name: Defiant Banner
defiant-banner.duration: until the start of your next turn
defiant-banner.note: Resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing equal to your Intelligence modifier until the start of your next turn. Allies inside your banner's aura gain the same resistance - that belongs on their sheets, not yours.

deitys-protection.name: Deity's Protection
deitys-protection.duration: until the start of your next turn
deitys-protection.note: Turn this on after you cast a domain spell. The resistance equals the rank of the domain spell you cast; domain focus spells are automatically heightened to half your level rounded up.

dire-form.name: Dire Form (hybrid shape)
dire-form.duration: while you are in your hybrid shape
dire-form.note: Enlarge: you become Large (if Medium or smaller), your reach increases by 5 feet, and you are clumsy 1.

dire-growth.name: Dire Growth (animal shape)
dire-growth.duration: while you remain in your animal shape
dire-growth.note: Enlarge: you become Large (if Medium or smaller), your reach increases by 5 feet, and you are clumsy 1.

feat-eternal-blessing.name: Eternal Blessing
feat-eternal-blessing.duration: permanent — you may Dismiss it, and it returns automatically after 1 minute
feat-eternal-blessing.note: You are continuously surrounded by bless at a spell rank equal to half your level (rounded up), radius 15 feet (it cannot be increased): you and allies inside gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls.

exude-demonic-corruption.name: Demonic Corruption
exude-demonic-corruption.duration: until the start of your next turn
exude-demonic-corruption.note: Your melee Strikes deal an extra 1d6 poison damage, and each creature that hits you with a melee unarmed attack or otherwise touches you takes 1d6 poison damage. The poison damage is 2d6 at 14th level and 3d6 at 20th.

eyes-that-see-eternity.name: Eyes that See Eternity
eyes-that-see-eternity.note: Costs 1 Mythic Point. You have the effects of Truesight (you see through illusions and magical darkness and can see invisible creatures) and roll all Perception checks with mythic proficiency.

flamboyant-athlete.name: Flamboyant Athlete (Panache)
flamboyant-athlete.note: While you have panache: climb and swim Speeds equal to half your land Speed; High Jump and Long Jump DCs decrease by 10 (doesn't combine with other DC reductions); a vertical Leap covers 5 feet and a horizontal Leap 15 feet (20 feet if your Speed is at least 30).

force-of-nature.name: Force of Nature (hybrid or animal shape)
force-of-nature.duration: while you are in your hybrid or animal shape
force-of-nature.note: Fast healing 5. If you take damage from a silver weapon, the fast healing deactivates until the end of your next turn.

ghost-wrangler.name: Ghost Wrangler
ghost-wrangler.duration: until the start of your next turn
ghost-wrangler.note: Your fists gain the effects of the ghost touch property rune, and you can make Strength-based skill checks against incorporeal creatures.

giants-lunge.name: Giant's Lunge
giants-lunge.note: All your melee weapons and unarmed attacks have 10-foot reach. This doesn't increase the reach of an attack that already has the reach trait, but it does combine with size-based reach increases such as Giant's Stature.

giants-stature.name: Giant's Stature
giants-stature.note: You are Large: your reach increases by 5 feet and you are clumsy 1 until you stop raging. Your equipment grows with you. Requires that you were Medium or smaller.

golden-body.name: Golden Body
golden-body.note: Fast healing 20: you regain 20 HP at the start of each of your turns as long as you have at least 1 HP. Track the healing yourself - the app has no fast-healing lane.

grand-medics-mask.name: Grand Medic's Mask
grand-medics-mask.note: Fast healing 5. A lost limb or body part regrows within 1 day. Immediately after you Cast a non-cantrip Spell that targets only one creature, you can also give that creature temporary Hit Points equal to the spell's rank until the start of your next turn.

grasping-reach.name: Extended Grasp
grasping-reach.note: While held in your extended grasp, a two-handed melee weapon that lacks reach and deals at least 1d6 damage gains 10-foot reach, and its damage die is reduced by one step.

greater-transformation.name: Oni Form (Greater)
greater-transformation.note: Your Oni Form lasts 10 minutes with no need to Sustain it, and while in it your reach increases by 5 feet (on top of the form's usual Large size and clumsy 1).

hardwood-armor.name: Hardwood Armor
hardwood-armor.duration: 10 minutes (Dismissible; using the impulse again ends the old one)
hardwood-armor.note: Medium wooden armor that uses your highest armor proficiency: AC Bonus +3, Dex Cap +2, Check Penalty -2, Speed Penalty -5 ft, Strength +2, Bulk 1, group wood. Your real armor's bonuses, runes and magical abilities are suppressed (runes that could apply are replicated onto the hardwood). You may also form a wooden shield in a free hand and Shield Block with it even without that feat, and that hand still counts as free for impulses; the shield decays if broken or if it leaves your grasp. At every 3rd level its Hardness +1, HP +4, BT +2. The app cannot swap armor statistics automatically — unequip your worn armor while this is active.

heavens-thunder.name: Heaven's Thunder
heavens-thunder.duration: until the end of your next turn
heavens-thunder.note: Your unarmed attacks and any monk weapons you wield deal additional electricity damage and additional sonic damage, each equal to that attack's number of damage dice. Any creature that successfully Grapples you, or that you successfully Grapple, takes that damage immediately after the check (using your unarmed attack's damage dice). If you know the Ki Blast ki spell you may have it deal electricity or sonic instead of force while this is active.

immortal-bear.name: Immortal Bear
immortal-bear.note: Fast healing 5 while you are in Ursine Avenger Form. Track the healing yourself - the app has no fast-healing lane.

infused-with-belkzens-might.name: Infused with Belkzen's Might
infused-with-belkzens-might.duration: until the end of your next turn
infused-with-belkzens-might.note: Infused with Belkzen's Might: expend one use of your storied skin's Living History. Your weapon and unarmed Strikes deal additional spirit damage equal to 1 plus half the number of Tattooed Historian feats you have (so 1 with one or two such feats, 2 with three or four, and so on).

metal-carapace.name: Metal Carapace
metal-carapace.duration: 10 minutes (Dismissible; using the impulse again ends the old one)
metal-carapace.note: Medium metal armor that uses your highest armor proficiency: AC Bonus +3, Dex Cap +2, Check Penalty -2, Speed Penalty -5 ft, Strength +2, Bulk 2, group plate, armor trait noisy. Your real armor's bonuses, runes and magical abilities are suppressed (any that could apply are replicated onto the carapace). You may also form a rusty steel shield in a free hand and Shield Block with it even without that feat, and that hand still counts as free for impulses; the shield crumbles to rust if broken or if it leaves your grasp. At every 3rd level the shield's Hardness +1, HP +4, BT +2. If you take damage from a critical hit the metal shatters and the impulse ends. The app cannot swap armor statistics automatically — unequip your worn armor while this is active.

pain-is-temporary.name: Pain is Temporary
pain-is-temporary.duration: until the end of your next turn
pain-is-temporary.note: Two actions, once per 10 minutes: you gain resistance 10 to all damage until the end of your next turn.

cat-rope-runner.name: On Ropes (Rope Runner)
cat-rope-runner.duration: while climbing or balancing on a rope or similar object
cat-rope-runner.note: Rope Runner: a climb Speed of 15 feet, but only when climbing ropes and similar objects. You aren't off-guard while Climbing or Balancing on a rope or similar object, and a success on an Athletics check to Climb or an Acrobatics check to Balance is a critical success instead.

scarred-hide.name: Scarred Hide (hybrid or animal shape)
scarred-hide.duration: while in your hybrid or animal shape
scarred-hide.note: Werecreature: while in your hybrid or animal shape you have resistance to non-silver slashing damage equal to half your level.

sentinels-orbit.name: Sentinel's Orbit (sentinel form)
sentinels-orbit.note: Starlit Sentinel: while in your sentinel form you have a fly Speed equal to your land Speed, or 20 feet if that is higher.

shore-gift.name: Shore Gift
shore-gift.duration: indefinite (use the action again to revert)
shore-gift.note: You walk on two legs: your land Speed becomes 25 feet. You lose the swim Speed from your merfolk ancestry (swim Speeds from other sources remain). Using the Shore Gift also counts as creating a disguise for Impersonate and automatically defeats Perception DCs to notice it.

stalwart-chant.name: Stalwart Chant
stalwart-chant.duration: against the effect of the mental save you failed
stalwart-chant.note: Stalwart Chant: you can use Stalwart Song against any mental effect. If you fail that save, you gain resistance to mental damage equal to half your level against the resulting effect. Turn this on for that effect only.

strand-strider-spider-shape.name: Spider Shape (Strand Strider)
strand-strider-spider-shape.note: Strand Strider: while in your spider shape you have a climb Speed of 25 feet.

the-tyrant-falls.name: The Tyrant Falls!
the-tyrant-falls.note: The Tyrant Falls!: at the start of each of your turns you become drained 1 or increase your drained value by 1, and you can't reduce or remove drained while this is active — but drained doesn't penalize your Fortitude save while it lasts. You can cast Invoke the Crimson Oath at will without spending Focus Points (with an increased area). Any melee weapon you wield gains the reach trait (or +5 feet of reach if it already had reach) and its Strikes deal an extra 2d6 vitality or void damage, whichever is more effective against the target.

unyielding-force.name: Unyielding Force (medium/heavy armor)
unyielding-force.duration: while wearing medium or heavy armor
unyielding-force.note: Unyielding Force: while you wear medium or heavy armor, your guardian's armor resistance to physical damage is 6 + half your level.

warped-by-rage.name: Warped by Rage (Immanence)

modifiers.appliesWhen: melee Strike damage while enlarged by the ikon's immanence

warped-by-rage.note: Immanence: you're affected by a 4th-rank Enlarge — you become Huge, your reach increases by 10 feet, you gain a +4 status bonus to melee damage and are clumsy 1. You can forgo this effect when your body ikon becomes empowered.

item-abysium-chunk.name: Carrying Abysium (Sickened 1)
item-abysium-chunk.note: A creature carrying this standard-grade, light-Bulk abysium chunk is sickened 1 (a poison effect). Switch off when the chunk is not carried. The chunk also sheds dim light in a 10-foot radius.

item-abysium-ingot.name: Carrying Abysium (Sickened 2)
item-abysium-ingot.note: A creature carrying this standard-grade, 1-Bulk abysium ingot is sickened 2 (a poison effect). Switch off when the ingot is not carried. It also sheds dim light in a 10-foot radius.

item-golden-wings.name: Assisted Flight
item-golden-wings.note: Assisted Flight: you can Leap 20 feet and must land on solid ground. You shed bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light 20 feet beyond, and take a -2 item penalty to Stealth to Hide and Sneak.

item-greater-golden-wings.name: Assisted Flight
item-greater-golden-wings.note: Assisted Flight: you can Leap 20 feet and must land on solid ground, and can spend an action to glide 5 feet down and 20 feet forward. You shed bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light 20 feet beyond, and take a -2 item penalty to Stealth to Hide and Sneak.

item-incandescent-sight.name: Incandescent Sight
item-incandescent-sight.note: Detects temperature gradients out to 30 feet, so you can spot living creatures and warm objects in the dark. Warm objects block it even when transparent (e.g. hot water).

item-instinct-crown.name: Instinct Crown Boon
item-instinct-crown.duration: until the end of your rage
item-instinct-crown.note: Once per day while raging, if the crown's instinct matches yours: Animal - Stride, +10 temporary HP, +3 damage and deadly d8 on your animal unarmed attacks. Dragon - adjacent attackers take 2d6 of your breath's damage type. Fury - quickened (Stride or Strike only). Giant - become Large, +5 ft reach, +2 damage with the larger weapon, your Strides leave difficult terrain. Spirit - raging resistance applies to all physical and poison damage, halved against magical attacks. Superstition - roll twice and take the higher on saves against magic, and raging resistance applies to all traditions. The separate once-per-day initiative activation adds 10 more temporary HP to Quick-Tempered's Rage.

item-major-golden-wings.name: Golden Wings (Assisted Flight)
item-major-golden-wings.note: Once per day. You can also Leap 20 feet and must land on solid ground. While active you shed bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for the next 20 feet.

item-rime-jar.name: Siphon Chill
item-rime-jar.note: For 8 hours you treat extreme cold as severe cold. The activation also removes the fatigued condition if it was caused by exposure to environmental cold.

item-azatas-grace.name: Azata's Grace
item-azatas-grace.note: +50 maximum and current Hit Points while active. You also gain the effects of the righteous call gift without expending that gift's daily use. Dismissing it casts scintillating pattern (your allies are unaffected).

item-skyrider-sword-greater.name: Ride the Skyrider Sword
item-skyrider-sword-greater.duration: until you Dismiss it or stop holding the sword in at least one hand
item-skyrider-sword-greater.note: Fly Speed of 25 feet or your land Speed, whichever is slower. While riding the sword you can't Strike with it except via its 2-action Fly-and-Strike activation.

item-stalwarts-ring.name: Stalwart's Ring
item-stalwarts-ring.note: 5 temporary Hit Points, gained by meditating on the ring during daily preparations. They last until your next daily preparations and only while you keep wearing the ring.

item-steamflight-pack.name: Steamflight Pack
item-steamflight-pack.note: Fly Speed 20 feet while the pack is running. It carries enough water for 20 minutes of operation and refills in 5 minutes; the on/off switch is a 2-action activation.

item-true-golden-wings.name: Assisted Flight
item-true-golden-wings.note: Once per day. For 10 minutes you can Leap 20 feet and gain a fly Speed equal to your Speed or 25 feet, whichever is greater. You emit bright light in a 20-foot radius (dim light 20 feet beyond), which is why Stealth suffers.

item-winged-greater.name: Take to the Skies
item-winged-greater.note: Greater winged rune: a fly Speed of 25 feet or your land Speed, whichever is slower. Once activated the wings stay tangible indefinitely; you can Dismiss it and reactivate without waiting an hour.

item-cloak-of-waves-clouds.name: Cut Air and Sea
item-cloak-of-waves-clouds.duration: until you next Activate the cloak
item-cloak-of-waves-clouds.note: Feathers form: fly Speed 40 feet. Activating for the scale form instead gives a swim Speed of 60 feet and the ability to breathe underwater - leave this mode off and use the swim form at the table.

item-cursed-dreamstone.name: Cursed Dreamstone
item-cursed-dreamstone.duration: as long as you possess the stone
item-cursed-dreamstone.note: Switch this on only if you failed the save against the curse. You are also fatigued whenever you wake from sleep, natural or magical, and you gain no bonus from the dreamstone. On a critical failure you additionally get one degree worse on every saving throw against sleep effects.

item-energy-breath-potion-greater.name: Energy Breath (Greater)
item-energy-breath-potion-greater.note: You have the Energy Breath action for 1 hour: 10d6 damage of the potion's energy type, basic save DC 37. Area/save by type — acid or electricity 30-foot line (Reflex), cold or fire 15-foot cone (Reflex), sonic 15-foot cone (Fortitude). After using it you can't do so again for 1d4 rounds.

item-flying-broomstick.name: Riding the Flying Broomstick
item-flying-broomstick.note: Guiding the broom with one hand gives a fly Speed of 20 feet; it can carry one passenger besides you. Activate—Lift Off (2 actions, concentrate, manipulate) toward a named destination on the same plane raises the fly Speed to 40 feet for up to 4 hours (about 16 miles) or until you Dismiss it — raise the speed to 40 by hand while that runs. Laden with more than 20 Bulk the broom takes a -10-foot penalty; above 30 Bulk it crashes. After the activation ends the broom can't be activated again for 1 hour.

item-giant-catch-pole.name: Wielding the Giant Catch Pole
item-giant-catch-pole.duration: while wielding the giant catch pole
item-giant-catch-pole.note: You are Clumsy 1 while wielding it (apply as a condition). The rope loop lets you Grapple without having a free hand, and the giant version can Grapple creatures up to your normal size limit rather than only Medium or smaller.

field-vial-mutagenist.name: Field Vial (Mutagenist)
field-vial-mutagenist.note: Advanced Vials (Mutagenist): while a field vial you drank is in effect you have resistance to physical damage equal to half your level.

guardians-armor.name: Guardian's Armor
guardians-armor.duration: while wearing medium or heavy armor
guardians-armor.note: While wearing medium or heavy armor you have resistance to physical damage equal to 1 + half your level. You can also rest normally in medium and heavy armor.

mode-mountaineering-training.name: Mountaineering Training
mode-mountaineering-training.duration: until the end of your next turn
mode-mountaineering-training.note: Mountaineering Training tactic: you and each signalled squadmate gain a climb Speed of 20 feet until the end of your next turn. While this tactic is prepared you can also use Warfare Lore in place of Athletics to Climb.

mode-mutagenist-field-vial.name: Field Vial (Mutagenist)
mode-mutagenist-field-vial.note: Advanced Vials (11th): drinking a field vial also gives you resistance to physical damage equal to half your level for the same duration. The vial also suppresses one mutagen drawback for 1 minute.

tactic-naval-training.name: Naval Training
tactic-naval-training.duration: until the end of your next turn
tactic-naval-training.note: Naval Training tactic: you and each signalled squadmate gain a swim Speed of 20 feet until the end of your next turn. While this tactic is prepared you can also use Warfare Lore in place of Athletics to Swim.

race-the-skies.name: Race the Skies
race-the-skies.note: Transcendence: for 1 minute you gain a fly Speed equal to your Speed or 20 feet, whichever is greater.

inexorable-iron.name: Inexorable Iron
inexorable-iron.note: Wielding a melee weapon in two hands: temporary HP equal to half your level (minimum 1) on entering Arcane Cascade and at the start of each of your turns in it.

curse-of-engulfing-flames.name: Engulfing Flames (cursebound)
curse-of-engulfing-flames.note: While cursebound: persistent fire damage equal to your cursebound value, and your fire immunity and resistance are suppressed.
